# name: The ball game won; the House of Blades; the ants fetch the flowers
# title: Are ta cu xahauax chique
# fols: fols. 25r–26v
Are ta cu xahauax chique ꜭaholab huzu ta xcam ri chiri chi cha, xe chacatah tah. Mavi quehe; xa Xibalba xe chacatah chic cumal ꜭaholab. “Ma ba quix bec, ix ꜭaholab. Coh chaah na; xa are ca ca coho ri ivech,” xvꜭhax cut ꜭaholab. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut. Are cu xoc ri qui quic, ta xcah cu chaah.

Catecut ta xqui choi qui chacon: “Naquipa chi ca chaco?” xeꜭha Xibalba. “He na qui cut,” xa xeꜭha ꜭaholab. “Xa ca cha ca cah cah ꜩel coꜩih,” xeꜭha Xibalba. “Vꜩ bala. Naquipa chi coꜩihal?” xeꜭha ꜭaholab chique Xibalba. “Huticab cacamuchih, huticab zaqui muchit, huticab cana muchit, huticab carinimac,” xeꜭha Xibalba. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut ꜭaholab.

Ta xcah cut qui cha; hunam qui chucab, ꜩaꜩ pu qui cha ri ꜭaholab; xa cu qui rvꜩ qui ꜭux ta xqui ya quib chi chacatahic ri ꜭaholab. Que quicot cut ri Xibalba ta xe chacatahic: “Vꜩ mix ca bano; nabe mixe ca chaco,” xeꜭha Xibalba. “Apa xchi be qui cama vi ri coꜩih?” xeꜭha chi qui ꜭux. “Quiꜩih ta acab chi ia ri ca coꜩih; ca chacom puch,” xe vꜭhax puch ꜭaholab Hunahpu, Xbalanque rumal Xibalba. “Vꜩ bala; acaba chi cut coh chaahic,” xeꜭha cut, ta xe pixaban quib.

Cate chi cut ta xe oc chi ꜭaholab pa Chaim Ha, v cab tihobal Xibalba. Are ta cut xahauax chic xe catacox tah rumal cha chanim tah, chi qui ꜭux; xe cam tah, chi qui ꜭux. Ma cu xe camic. Ta xeꜭha chire cha, ta xqui pixabah: “Are ive ri ronohel v tiohil chicop,” xeꜭha chire cha. Ma cu xe zilab chic; xa hun cah chi vi cha ronohel. Are cut e ꜭo chi chiri pa Chaim Ha chacab, ta xqui ziquih ronohel zanic: “Chai zanic, Chequen zanic, quix petoc, quix oho ivonohel; oh i cama ronohel v vach coꜩih qui chacon ahauab.” “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut.

Ta xe be cu ri zanic conohel, e camol coꜩih v ticon Huncame, Vvcub Came. Mier oc cut chi qui pixabah chahal qui coꜩih ri Xibalba: “La qui chivila ca coꜩih; mi ya chi elecaxic rumal ri mixe ca chaco ri ꜭaholab. Ana vi xpe vi rilo ca chacon cumal? Mahabi. Chi varah hun acab.” “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut.

Ma cu xquina ri chahal ticon. Xaloc chi qui racuh qui chi chu cab tac che ticon puch; que be chacala chiri, xavi xere chi qui ꜭhabeh ri qui bix: “Xpurpuvec, Xpurpuvec,” ꜭha ri hun ta choquic. “Puhuyu, Puhuyu,” cha chic ta choquic. Ri Puhuyu v bi e caib chi chahal ticon v ticon Huncame, Vvcub Came. Ma cu ca quina ri zanic elecai qui chahem, ca bolovic, ca tucuvic e rai coꜩih, ri ca be ca tova vloc coꜩih chuvi che, re ca zicou cuꜭ chuxe che ri coꜩih.

Xa quehe chi qui racuh qui chi ri chahalib; mana re ca qui nao ca ꜭux qui he, ca ꜭux qui xic. Are ca quirixic coꜩih, ca ca cah vloc, re ca zicouic, re ca be ca tova vloc. Libah chi cut xnoh cahib ꜩel coꜩih; tiquitoh chi cut ta xzaquiric.

Catecut ta xul zamahel taconel: “Que petoc,” ca ꜭha ahau; “huzuc chi qui cam vla ri ca chacon,” xe vꜭhax cut ꜭaholab. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut. Qui tique laon cu ri coꜩih cahib ꜩel; ta xe bec, ta xe opon cu chi qui vach ahau, ahauab, cu caam coꜩih ꜫuz v vach. Quehe cut xe chacatah vi Xibalba; xa zanic xqui tac ri ꜭaholab; xa hun acabil xqui chap zanic ta qui ya pa ꜩel. Quehe cut xe zaccah e ri conohel Xibalba, zacbu e qui vach rumal ri coꜩih.

Catecut xqui tac ri chahal coꜩih: “Naquipa rumal mix ia ca coꜩih chi elecaxic? Are ca coꜩih vae ca vilo,” xe vꜭhax chahal. “Ma ba xca nao, at ahau; mi na re xcuyu ca he,” xeꜭha cut. Catepuch xhix qui chi, qui tohbal qui chahin chi elecaxic. Quehe cut qui chacatahic Huncame, Vvcub Came cumal Hunahpu, Xbalanque, v xe ri banoh ri. Ta xqui cam ri qui chi herebac qui chi Purpuec, herebac vacamic.

Cate chi cut ta xcah chaah; xavi xere hunam que chaahic. Xqueleh chi cu chaah, ta xe pixaban chi cu quib zacaric chic, xeꜭha Xibalba. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha ꜭaholab, ta xqueleh.
